theater: 卡加拉河谷至坎帕拉公路線

battle.name: 烏干達-坦桑尼亞戰爭
battle.theater: 卡加拉河谷至坎帕拉公路線
battle.brief: 一九七八年八月，烏干達武裝越過卡加拉河進入坦桑尼亞，十月三十日阿明下令全面入侵，衝突由邊境據點延伸到通往坎帕拉的公路線。坦軍以中國援助的五九式中型坦克組成裝甲先鋒，該型車是一九五九年中國第一種國產中型坦克，也是友好國家裝甲部隊的制式裝備，此役中它承擔突進、破壞與反裝甲任務。

kit.name: 59式中型坦克
kit.history: 中國人民解放軍機械化步兵師與裝甲師的主力中型坦克，承擔機動作戰、火力支援及反裝甲任務，並作為友好國家裝甲部隊的制式裝備。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方是烏干達與坦桑尼亞兩個東非國家，加上各自的盟友、援助國與流亡武裝。烏干達方面，總統伊迪·阿明兼任武裝部隊最高指揮者，首都坎帕拉的國防部與參謀部直接調度正規軍，參戰兵力在七萬人上下，其中相當一部分是民兵、地方武裝與未經訓練的新兵；利比亞依阿明之請派出約二千五百人的部隊，連同一批坦克、步兵戰車、火箭砲與作戰飛機，巴基斯坦與沙特阿拉伯提供後勤與經濟援助。坦桑尼亞方面，總統朱利葉斯·尼瑞爾自任最高決策者，人民國防軍作戰序列在開戰前約四萬人，動員之後連同警察、獄警、後備役與人民民兵增到十萬人以上；一九七八年底在肯尼亞內羅畢召開的流亡反對派聯席會議上，二十多個反阿明組織被拉上同一條線，一九七九年三月莫西會議進一步組成烏干達全國解放軍，下轄蒂托·奧凱洛與大衛·奧伊特-奧喬克率領的特種部隊、約韋里·穆塞韋尼率領的救國陣線，以及阿肯納·普奧約克率領的拯救烏干達運動等二十八個單位。莫三比克、尚比亞、安哥拉、衣索比亞、阿爾及利亞與中國在外交與物資上支援坦方，非洲統一組織則以不干涉為由拒絕派兵。戰場橫跨坦桑尼亞西北部的卡加拉河谷與烏干達西部的姆巴拉拉、馬薩卡，中部的坎帕拉、恩德培、金賈，直到東部的托羅羅。
countriesEn: The belligerents in this war were the two East African states of Uganda and Tanzania, together with their allies, the states that provided aid, and the exile armed groups on each side. On the Ugandan side President Idi Amin acted as the supreme commander of the armed forces, and the defence ministry and general staff in Kampala ran the regular army directly; the committed force numbered around seventy thousand men, a substantial part of it made up of militia, local levies and recruits who had never been trained. Libya sent some two thousand five hundred men at Amin's request, together with tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, rocket launchers and combat aircraft, while Pakistan and Saudi Arabia provided logistics and economic aid. On the Tanzanian side President Julius Nyerere took the highest decisions himself; the order of battle of the People's Defence Force stood at about forty thousand men before the war and was swelled by police, prison guards, reservists and the People's Militia to more than one hundred thousand. At the joint meeting of exiled opposition groups held in Nairobi, Kenya, at the end of 1978, more than twenty anti-Amin organisations were drawn onto a single line, and the Moshi conference of March 1979 went on to form the Uganda National Liberation Army, embracing twenty-eight units including the Kikosi Maalum led by Tito Okello and David Oyite-Ojok, the FRONASA led by Yoweri Museveni, and the Save Uganda Movement led by Akena Pwoogi. Mozambique, Zambia, Angola, Ethiopia, Algeria and China supported the Tanzanian side diplomatically and materially, while the Organisation of African Unity declined to send troops on grounds of non-interference. The battlefield ran from the Kagera valley in north-western Tanzania through Mbarara and Masaka in western Uganda, and through Kampala, Entebbe and Jinja in the centre, to Tororo in the east.
people: 決定開打的是坦桑尼亞總統朱利葉斯·尼瑞爾。阿明的越境部隊在幾日內吃掉整個卡加拉區之後，他於一九七八年十一月二日正式宣戰，並把目標由把越境部隊趕回坦境升級為打倒阿明；坦方的作戰指揮由人民國防軍參謀部分層負責，前線以旅為基本作戰單位，第201旅與第208旅是攻勢中的骨幹，總理阿卜杜拉·特瓦利布等政治人物在首都一線督戰。對面的最高決策者是伊迪·阿明，他自一九七一年政變掌權後清洗軍隊與政府，趕走總統米爾頓·奧博特，一九七八年更遭自己的軍官團解除軍職；他以反擊一千輛坦克越境為名發動戰爭，戰前又在一場交通意外中廢掉副總統穆斯特發·阿德里斯，種下軍心分裂的根由。關鍵的外部人物是卡扎菲，他在阿明最危急時派來約二千五百人的利比亞部隊與坦克、火箭砲、戰鬥機，令盧卡雅的戰局一度逆轉，該部被擊潰後他於一九七九年四月初把部隊撤走，阿明則在三月二十七日逃離坎帕拉、四月流亡利比亞。反對陣線裡，米爾頓·奧博特是最終回國執政的人；一九七九年四月十三日被推舉為臨時總統的是前大學校長尤素福·盧萊，隨後是戈弗雷·比奈薩與保羅·穆萬加的軍委會；約韋里·穆塞韋尼與蒂托·奧凱洛則在戰後分別走上武裝反對與軍事政變兩條路。
peopleEn: The man who decided to fight was the Tanzanian president Julius Nyerere. After Amin's invading troops had swallowed the whole Kagera region within a few days, he formally declared war on 2 November 1978 and raised the aim from simply expelling the invaders to bringing down Amin. On the Tanzanian side the conduct of operations was divided between the general staff of the People's Defence Force and the brigade commanders in the line; the brigade was the basic manoeuvre unit, and the 201st and 208th Brigades formed the core of the offensive, while politicians such as Prime Minister Abdallah Twalib pressed the effort from the capital. The opposing supreme decision-maker was Idi Amin, who had seized power in the 1971 coup, purged the army and the government and driven out President Milton Obote, and who in 1978 was relieved of his command by his own officers. He launched the war under the pretext of repelling a crossing by a thousand tanks, and shortly beforehand he had disabled Vice-President Mustafa Adrisi in a road accident, laying the ground for the army to split. The decisive outside figure was Muammar Gaddafi, who sent about two thousand five hundred Libyan troops with tanks, rocket launchers and fighters when Amin was closest to collapse; the turn of the battle at Lukaya was briefly reversed by them, and after that force was destroyed he withdrew it in the first days of April 1979, while Amin fled Kampala on 27 March and went into exile in Libya. On the opposition side Milton Obote was the man who eventually came back to rule; the presidency proposed on 13 April 1979 was that of the former university vice-chancellor Yusuf Lule, followed by Godfrey Binaisa and then the military commission of Paul Muwanga, while Yoweri Museveni and Tito Okello went on to take the road of armed opposition and of a coup respectively.
kits: 卡面這支一九五九年定型的中國五九式中型坦克，是中國自行研製的第一代中型坦克，車體源自蘇聯T-54A，戰鬥全重約三十六噸，裝備一百毫米線膛加農炮、五點四五毫米均質鋼裝甲與大出力柴油機，公路最大速度約五十公里每小時，乘員四人，設計任務正是機械化步兵師與裝甲師所要求的機動作戰、火力支援與反裝甲。它同時是友好國家裝甲部隊的制式裝備：據軍援清單與受援國裝備記錄，坦桑尼亞自一九七〇年代起即以五九式裝備裝甲部隊，並由中國派出的軍事顧問與教官訓練乘員與維修組；一九七九年這場戰爭裡，坦軍的裝甲力量就是以五九式為骨幹構成，本土自製的同型車並不存在，只能靠援外與引進維持。本役的輕武器屬另一條血脈：坦軍步兵以中國製五六式步槍、五六式輕機槍與衝鋒槍為主，輔以蘇制AK-47與RPG-7火箭筒，彈藥為七六二毫米與一四五毫米中間威力一系；重裝備有蘇制BM-21多管火箭砲、中國製五九式坦克與自走砲，坦桑尼亞空軍使用中國製殲-六與殲-七B戰鬥機。烏軍裝備多為英制與蘇制舊式步槍，砲兵車輛有限，戰機多屬早年購入的舊機型，因零件與燃油短缺而大部分停飛。利比亞援軍帶來T-54與T-55坦克、BTR步兵戰車、BM-21火箭砲、米格-21戰鬥機與圖-22轟炸機。補給上，坦方以數千輛卡車組成縱隊式供應線，烏方多靠步行與徵用車輛。
kitsEn: The Type 59 medium tank shown on the card, finalised in 1959, was the first indigenous medium tank designed in China; its hull derives from the Soviet T-54A, it weighs some thirty-six tonnes in combat order, and it carries a 100mm rifled gun, 45mm of homogeneous steel armour and a high-output diesel engine, with a road speed of about fifty kilometres an hour and a crew of four. Its design task was exactly the one written on the card: the manoeuvre, fire support and anti-armour work required by a mechanised infantry division or an armoured division, and it was at the same time the standard equipment of the armoured forces of friendly states. According to the aid lists and the equipment records of the receiving countries, Tanzania equipped its armoured units with the Type 59 from the early 1970s onward, and Chinese military advisers and instructors trained the crews and the maintenance teams; in the war of 1979 the armoured element of the Tanzanian army was built around the Type 59, since no domestic model of the kind existed and the tank could only be sustained by foreign supply and by training. The light weapons of the campaign belong to another line of descent: Tanzanian infantry fought with Chinese Type 56 rifles, Type 56 light machine guns and submachine guns, supported by Soviet AK-47 rifles and RPG-7 launchers, firing the 7.62mm and 14.5mm intermediate cartridges; heavy equipment comprised Soviet BM-21 multiple rocket launchers, Chinese Type 59 tanks and self-propelled guns, and the Tanzanian air force flew Chinese-built J-6 and J-7B fighters. The Ugandan forces were equipped largely with older British and Soviet rifles, had a limited number of artillery vehicles, and their aircraft were mostly obsolete types bought years earlier, grounded for want of spares and fuel. The Libyan auxiliaries brought T-54 and T-55 tanks, BTR infantry fighting vehicles, BM-21 rocket launchers, MiG-21 fighters and Tu-22 bombers. On the logistics side the Tanzanians built a pipeline of several thousand lorries along the line of advance, and the Ugandans relied on foot movement and on requisitioned vehicles.
tactics: 坦方前期的教訓是準備不足：阿明的越境部隊在幾天之內吃掉整個卡加拉區，坦軍只能退守邊境，遲到十一月底才封住突破口，十二月把烏軍逐出坦境。此後尼瑞爾接納流亡反對派參戰，戰術重心由邊境反擊改成攻擊。一九七九年一月，一萬餘名先頭部隊在五九式戰車、殲-六與殲-七B護航下越境，以BM-21火箭砲先打烏軍的集結地與營地，再以裝甲加步兵沿姆巴拉拉、馬薩卡至坎帕拉的公路縱隊推進，前進速度取決於卡車與燃料，戰線一旦拉長就必須停下整補。盧卡雅一役最能看出其戰法：北面沼澤擋住正面，坦軍讓第201旅涉水強渡，同時以裝備較好的第208旅向西南迂迴沼澤西側；三月十日利比亞精銳以十五輛T-55、數十輛步兵戰車與火箭砲空襲第201旅得手，但三月十一至十二日重新集結的兩個旅南北夾擊，把利軍打崩。空戰同樣決定性：坦空軍連續多日轟炸坎帕拉、金賈與托羅羅，摧毀烏軍與利軍的有生力量，卡扎菲四月初派出的圖-22投彈多數未命中目標。烏軍則以鬆散、缺油少彈的游擊式退卻應付，士氣在三月崩潰，四月十日聯軍進軍坎帕拉時只遇到零星抵抗。
tacticsEn: The first lesson on the Tanzanian side was a lack of preparation. Within a few days Amin's invading troops had overrun the whole Kagera region, the Tanzanians could only fall back to the border, plugging the breach only late in November and pushing the Ugandans out of Tanzania during December. From then on Nyerere took the exile groups into his coalition and the purpose of the campaign changed from a border counter-attack to an invasion. In January 1979 an advance force of more than ten thousand men crossed the border under the cover of Type 59 tanks and J-6 and J-7B fighters, opened with BM-21 rocket salvos against the Ugandan assembly areas and camps, and then pushed along the Mbarara, Masaka and Kampala road in armoured and infantry columns, the pace of the advance being set by trucks and fuel, so that the line had to halt for resupply whenever it stretched too thin. The fighting at Lukaya shows their method best. Swamps to the north blocked the direct approach, so the Tanzanians sent the 201st Brigade to force its way across the water while the better equipped 208th Brigade swung south-west round the western edge of the marsh. On 10 March a Libyan elite force with fifteen T-55 tanks, several dozen infantry fighting vehicles and rocket launchers bombed the 201st Brigade from the air and routed it, but on 11 and 12 March the two brigades, once regrouped, closed from the south and the north-west and destroyed the Libyans. The air war was decisive in the same way: the Tanzanian air force bombed Kampala, Jinja and Tororo on successive days and wrecked the fighting power of the Ugandan and Libyan troops, while the Tu-22 sent by Gaddafi in the first days of April dropped its bombs without hitting a target. The Ugandans answered with a loose, short of fuel and ammunition, guerrilla-style withdrawal; their morale broke in March, and when the coalition entered Kampala on 10 April it met only scattered resistance.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下，各家統計差距頗大，只宜當作量級看。戰爭自一九七八年十月三十日阿明下令越境起，到一九七九年六月三日坦軍開始撤出為止，地點是坦桑尼亞卡加拉區與烏干達大部分領土。兵力方面，烏干達軍隊七萬餘人，利比亞派遣軍約二千五百至三千人，坦桑尼亞軍隊十萬餘人，烏干達全國解放軍六千餘人，真正投入一九七九年一月攻勢的先頭部隊約一萬人。傷亡方面，據較常被引用的統計，烏軍約一千人陣亡，利比亞軍約四百人，坦軍三百七十三人，解放軍一百五十人。日程極為密集：十一月二日尼瑞爾宣戰，十一月底坦軍封住卡加拉，十二月烏軍退出坦境；一九七九年三月十日利軍在盧卡雅擊潰第201旅，三月十一至十二日坦軍反擊得手，三月二十七日阿明逃離坎帕拉，四月一日恩德培失守，四月十日聯軍進軍坎帕拉、四月十一日占領，四月十三日盧萊被推舉為臨時總統，六月三日開始撤軍。地理上，姆萬薩至坎帕拉的公路約九百公里，卡加拉河谷至坎帕拉直線約六百公里；盧卡雅之戰利軍精銳投入十五輛T-55坦克、數十部步兵戰車與BM-21火箭砲。阿明所稱此前已有一千輛坦克越境之說，與實際可見的兵裝並不相符。
dataEn: The figures that can be given are roughly these, and since the estimates of the various sides differ considerably they should be read as orders of magnitude. The war ran from 30 October 1978, when Amin ordered the crossing, to 3 June 1979, when the Tanzanian troops began to withdraw, fought in the Kagera region of Tanzania and over most of Ugandan territory. On strength, the Ugandan army numbered more than seventy thousand men, the Libyan expeditionary force about two and a half to three thousand, the Tanzanian army more than one hundred thousand, and the Uganda National Liberation Army more than six thousand; the actual advance force committed to the offensive of January 1979 was about ten thousand men. On losses, by the counts most often quoted, the Ugandan army lost roughly one thousand dead, the Libyan force about four hundred, the Tanzanian army 373, and the liberation army 150. The timetable is very crowded: Nyerere declared war on 2 November, the Tanzanians sealed the Kagera front at the end of November and the Ugandans were out of Tanzania by December; on 10 March 1979 the Libyans routed the 201st Brigade at Lukaya, the Tanzanian counter-attack succeeded on 11 and 12 March, Amin fled Kampala on 27 March, Entebbe fell on 1 April, the coalition entered Kampala on 10 April and occupied it on the 11th, Lule was proposed as interim president on 13 April, and the withdrawal began on 3 June. On geography, the road from Mwanza to Kampala is about nine hundred kilometres and the straight line from the Kagera valley to Kampala about six hundred; the Libyan elite at Lukaya committed fifteen T-55 tanks, several dozen infantry fighting vehicles and BM-21 rocket launchers. There is also Amin's claim that a thousand tanks had crossed into Uganda earlier, which does not match the weapons actually seen.
cause: 導火索是阿明一方的越境襲擊。兩國原本關係不錯，奧博特與尼瑞爾在獨立運動時期就是舊交，一九六七年還與肯亞組建東非共同體；一九七一年阿明趁奧博特出訪新加坡發動政變，奧博特流亡坦桑尼亞，一九七二年在尼瑞爾支持下率支持者自坦桑尼亞北部攻入烏干達失敗，阿明反過來以殘酷手段對待境內的坦桑尼亞青年，兩國自此交惡。到一九七八年，阿明政權在咖啡價格崩跌、軍隊腐化、清洗蘭芝族與阿喬利族、九月全國騷亂與十月初刺殺未遂之後已經瀕臨崩潰，外界普遍認為他發動戰爭是為了轉移矛盾並另開外部戰場。一九七八年十月三十日，阿明對坦桑尼亞宣戰，下令部隊越過卡加拉河，並聲稱卡加拉區原本就屬於烏干達、此前已有一千輛坦克入侵，所以是自衛反擊。坦方先求自衛，把越境部隊趕出卡加拉區；尼瑞爾向非洲統一組織求援而只得到不干涉的沉默，遂於十一月二日宣戰，把反擊進行到底。
causeEn: The trigger was the crossing into Tanzanian territory by Amin's army. Relations between the two countries had once been good: Obote and Nyerere were old friends from the independence movement, and in 1967 Uganda joined Kenya and Tanzania in the East African Community. In 1971 Amin seized power in a coup while Obote was visiting Singapore; Obote fled into exile in Tanzania and in 1972 tried to march into Uganda from northern Tanzania with his supporters and with Nyerere's backing, and failed, whereupon Amin took out his anger on Tanzanian young men by cruel means and the two countries fell out. By 1978 the Amin regime, hit by the collapse in coffee prices, by military corruption, by the massacres of the Langi and Acholi, by nationwide rioting in September and by an unsuccessful attempt on his own life in early October, was close to collapse, and it was widely held that he started the war to divert attention from his internal troubles and to open a front abroad. On 30 October 1978 Amin declared war on Tanzania, ordered his troops across the Kagera, and claimed that the Kagera region had always belonged to Uganda and that a thousand tanks had already invaded, so that his move was pure self-defence. The Tanzanians at first sought only to clear their own territory, but Nyerere's appeal to the Organisation of African Unity met with a silence of non-interference, so on 2 November he declared war and carried the counter-offensive through to the end.
impact: 這是非洲去殖民化完成之後，大陸上第一次由一國以武力推翻另一國的政權。烏干達的後果最為深遠：阿明垮台流亡，盧萊、比奈薩、穆萬加軍委會、奧博特回國接連上來，一九八〇年十二月奧博特當選後，穆塞韋尼指責選舉舞弊，率人民抵抗軍打起持續多年的叢林戰爭，直到一九八六年推翻奧博特才告一段落；解放軍接管後的治理混亂與政治暴力長期消耗這個國家。坦桑尼亞雖是勝方，代價卻不輕：戰爭造成短期內難以恢復的破壞與龐大軍費，戰後還要在烏境內長期駐軍擔當維和角色，國庫為之空虛，幾年後尼瑞爾也因國內經濟衰退而辭職；此役還令坦桑尼亞與鄰國關係一度緊張，國際上也有人質疑一國以武力改變他國政權的做法。中國則藉軍援與軍事顧問團在非洲的影響力再上一層，裝甲部隊的整建、射擊訓練與技術傳授方式，也從這批援助中逐步建立起來。
impactEn: This was the first time since decolonisation that one African state had overturned the government of another by force. The consequences were deepest in Uganda. Amin collapsed and went into exile; Lule, Binaisa, the military commission of Muwanga and the return of Obote followed one another in quick succession; after Obote won the election of December 1980, Museveni accused the poll of being rigged, raised the People's Resistance Army and fought a bush war that ran for years and did not end until he overthrew Obote in 1986; and the disorder and political violence that followed the takeover by the liberation army drained the country for a long time. Tanzania was the victor but paid for it: the war brought damage that could not be repaired quickly and a military bill of size, the occupation of Uganda had to be maintained for a long stretch in a peacekeeping role, the treasury was left empty, and a few years later Nyerere too resigned because of the decline of the domestic economy. The campaign also soured relations between Tanzania and its neighbours for a time, and there was international unease about a state changing another state's government by force. For China the campaign added a further layer to the influence built in Africa through military aid and advisory missions, and the methods of forming armoured units, of gunnery training and of technical instruction grew out of the same aid.
result: 結果是坦桑尼亞的徹底勝利與阿明政權的垮台。戰局的轉折點在盧卡雅：利比亞精銳一度擊潰坦軍第201旅，但三月十一至十二日重新集結的第201旅與第208旅南北夾擊，把利軍的裝備與士氣一併打散；坦空軍隨後連續轟炸坎帕拉、金賈與托羅羅，摧毀了烏軍與利軍的有生力量，三月二十七日阿明棄坎帕拉逃往金賈，四月一日恩德培失守，四月十日聯軍進軍坎帕拉、四月十一日占領，全城只遇零星抵抗，戰爭至此基本結束。六月三日坦軍開始撤出，烏干達全國解放軍接管政權。但勝仗並沒有帶來穩定：政權更迭之後是比奈薩被軍委會撤職、奧博特回國、選舉爭議與叢林戰爭，戰爭留下的種子比它推翻的政權活得更久。對坦桑尼亞而言，這是一場贏了戰役卻付出國力的戰爭，也是它以武力改變鄰國政權這一步的起點；對五九式坦克而言，這是它的早期外銷裝備第一次成建制出現在大規模跨境作戰之中。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Tanzanian victory and the fall of the Amin regime. The turning point was Lukaya. The Libyan elite routed the Tanzanian 201st Brigade, but on 11 and 12 March the 201st and 208th brigades, once regrouped, closed from the south and the north-west and broke the equipment and the morale of the Libyan force alike; the Tanzanian air force then bombed Kampala, Jinja and Tororo on successive days and wrecked the fighting power of the Ugandan and Libyan troops; on 27 March Amin left Kampala for Jinja, Entebbe fell on 1 April, the coalition entered Kampala on 10 April and occupied it on the 11th against only scattered resistance, and the war was essentially over. The Tanzanians began to withdraw on 3 June, and the Uganda National Liberation Army took over the government. But the victory brought no stability: after the change of government came Binaisa's removal by the military commission, Obote's return, the disputed election and the bush war, and the seeds of the war outlived the regime it had overthrown. For Tanzania this was a war won at the cost of the treasury and the beginning of a step by which it changed the government of a neighbouring country by force; for the Type 59 tank it was the first time that an early export of the type appeared in a large-scale cross-border operation in formed units.
